title: Alternatively spliced exon regulates context-dependent MEF2D higher-order assembly during myogenesis.
authors: Gonczi, Monika; Teixeira, Joao M C; Barrera-Vilarmau, Susana; Mediani, Laura; Antoniani, Francesco; Nagy, Tamas Milan; Feher, Krisztina; Raduly, Zsolt; Ambrus, Viktor; Tozser, Jozsef; Barta, Endre; Kover, Katalin E; Csernoch, Laszlo; Carra, Serena; Fuxreiter, Monika
one_liner_zh: 该文研究MEF2D可变剪接β结构域通过相分离和聚集调控肌生成转录，结合MD模拟和NMR分析构象，虽涉及蛋白-DNA转录调控但未聚焦TF-DNA结合建模，方法可迁移至本课题。
abstract: During muscle cell differentiation, the alternatively spliced, acidic beta-domain potentiates transcription of Myocyte-specific Enhancer Factor 2 (Mef2D). Sequence analysis by the FuzDrop method indicates that the beta-domain can serve as an interaction element for Mef2D higher-order assembly. In accord, we observed Mef2D mobile nuclear condensates in C2C12 cells, similar to those formed through liquid-liquid phase separation. In addition, we found Mef2D solid-like aggregates in the cytosol, the presence of which correlated with higher transcriptional activity. In parallel, we observed a progress in the early phase of myotube development, and higher MyoD and desmin expression. In accord with our predictions, the formation of aggregates was promoted by rigid beta-domain variants, as well as by a disordered beta-domain variant, capable of switching between liquid-like and solid-like higher-order states. Along these lines, NMR and molecular dynamics simulations corroborated that the beta-domain can sample both ordered and disordered interactions leading to compact and extended conformations. These results suggest that beta-domain fine-tunes Mef2D higher-order assembly to the cellular context, which provides a platform for myogenic regulatory factors and the transcriptional apparatus during the developmental process.
abstract_zh: 在肌肉细胞分化过程中，选择性剪接的酸性β结构域增强肌细胞特异性增强因子2（Mef2D）的转录。通过FuzDrop方法进行的序列分析表明，β结构域可作为Mef2D高阶组装的相互作用元件。与此一致，我们在C2C12细胞中观察到Mef2D移动核凝聚体，类似于通过液-液相分离形成的结构。此外，我们在细胞质中发现了Mef2D固体样聚集体，其存在与更高的转录活性相关。同时，我们观察到肌管发育早期阶段的进展，以及更高的MyoD和desmin表达。与我们的预测相符，聚集体的形成受到刚性β结构域变体以及能够切换液态和固态高阶状态的无序β结构域变体的促进。沿着这些方向，核磁共振（NMR）和分子动力学模拟证实，β结构域可以采样有序和无序的相互作用，导致紧凑和延伸构象。这些结果表明，β结构域将Mef2D高阶组装微调至细胞环境，为发育过程中的肌源性调节因子和转录装置提供了平台。
